title: Terraform & Infrastructure as Code
blurb: Infrastructure as code from zero: how Terraform plans and applies, state, backends and locking, modules, count and for_each, zero-downtime changes, secrets, multiple providers, production-grade modules, testing, team workflows and CI/CD, a worked AWS project and interview answers, with Python simulations of plans, dependency graphs, drift and version constraints.
sources: Yevgeniy Brikman, Terraform: Up & Running, 3rd ed. (O'Reilly, 2022), ch. 1-10 (topic map and fact checking; all wording and examples are original)
Official Terraform documentation: developer.hashicorp.com/terraform (language, CLI, S3 backend, state, tests, import and moved blocks)
